options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Victory Location
options.doc:
Optionally moves the final victory location earlier to reduce the number of locations in the multiworld.

- **Snakes on a Planet (default):** The game goes all the way to "Moon, The". This gives the longest game.
- **Secret Cache:** The game stops at the end of Cool World. This gives the middlest-length game.
- **Captured Goldfish:** The game stops at the end of The Sewers. This gives the shortest game.

options.name: Enabled Buffs
options.doc:
Enables various buffs that affect how the rat behaves. All are enabled by default.

- **Well Fed:** Gets more done
- **Lucky:** One free success
- **Energized:** Moves faster
- **Stylish:** Better RNG
- **Confident:** Ignore a trap
- **Smart:** Next check is progression

options.name: Enabled Traps
options.doc:
Enables various traps that affect how the rat behaves. All are enabled by default.

- **Upset Tummy:** Gets less done
- **Unlucky:** Worse RNG
- **Sluggish:** Moves slower
- **Distracted:** Skip a "step"
- **Startled:** Run towards start
- **Conspiratorial:** Next check is trap
- **Poison:** Dies

options.name: Death Item Replacement %
options.doc:
Has no effect if "Poison" traps are disabled. Otherwise:

Controls what percentage of trap items added to the pool should be replaced by "poison" items. The percentage is
taken from the items that are INTENDED to be traps, so you can disable all other traps and still get the same number
of "poison" items as you would otherwise have.

Specifically, items with "poison" auras are held back, and then this configured percentage of random trap items are
replaced by copies of the items that were held back.

Whole numbers only.

Default: 2 (percent).
options.doc_html:

Specifically, items with "poison" auras are held back, and then this configured percentage of random trap items are replaced by copies of the items that were held back.

Whole numbers only.

Default: 2 (percent).
options.doc_fr:
N'a aucun effet si les pièges "Poison" sont désactivés. Sinon:

Contrôler le pourcentage d'éléments de piège ajoutés au pool par des éléments "poison". Le pourcentage est pris des éléments qui sont INTENDUS pour être des pièges, de sorte que vous pouvez désactiver tous les autres pièges et obtenir toujours le même nombre d'éléments "poison" que vous auriez autrement.

Plus précisément, les éléments avec des auras "poison" sont retenus en arrière, puis ce pourcentage configuré d'éléments pièges aléatoires sont remplacés par des copies des éléments qui ont été retenus en arrière.

Nombres entiers seulement.

Default: 2 (pourcentage).
